items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Not that band. Buster Buster? No. Not the time I know.

ctx.x: Buster, I think, played with him for a while. And Dick Thompson. Buster Buster. No, no.

Not that band. Buster Buster? No. Not the time I know. See, this band was way back then, man, before. Way back then. Way back then. Years ago, Korns had a book out, and that was the only Negro band picture was ever advertising anything that had black and tan band in the advertising, in Korns Music Book. Do you remember that? Yeah. And they had their uniforms, man, so different. Yeah.
I'd like to say that, that came out.
